data.narrative:
Victus AI is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Jesse Hamel. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe comprising 10 private companies and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), with primary reliance on three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M).

A peer-median approach, the sole triangulation method applicable given data constraints, yields an implied valuation of $400M. This reflects the median across the three-company peer set, which ranges from $125M to $1.0B. The dispersion across this set—a 8x spread between floor and ceiling—reflects material variance in how the market currently values early-stage defense-tech operators, likely driven by differences in technical differentiation, customer traction, and capital deployment stage.

Synthesizing the available evidence supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. Key uncertainties limiting confidence in this range include: (1) limited sample size (n=3), (2) adjacency rather than exact stage matching for two peers, and (3) absence of revenue or customer metrics to contextualize peer valuations. Any final valuation should account for Victus AI's specific product maturity, customer pipeline, and technical defensibility relative to the peer cohort.
